name: Pinned Down Combat Suppression
scope: AI behaviour only; player features explicitly excluded by user
evidence: Main PBO extracted with HEMTT; AI event/FSM/stance/skills/hearing/bootstrap paths inspected selectively, relevant source hashes compared with preserved 3559900745. Not a complete mod review. No production changes or live audit.
evaluate: AI suppression and suppressive-fire decisions and execution
Stance-dependent AI suppression and startle reactions, where implemented
AI combat awareness and contact detection
AI-specific CBA controls, event sources, locality/HC ownership, cleanup, repeat behaviour and performance
Compare against preserved earlier Pinned Down suppression sources and current WAIT behaviour; identify changes and useful improvements without assuming parity
excluded: Player visual, camera and auditory effects
acceptance: No implementation or physical acceptance credit. Inspect complete relevant source/caller paths and licence before adaptation; validate actual behaviour when audits are authorised.

findings.observed: Suppression FSM, attach, bootstrap, skill degradation, close-fire reaction and release helpers match preserved source byte-for-byte. AIsuppression delta expands Suppressed arguments and invokes the new awareness reveal helper.
findings.disposition: Retain provenance under the new ID; do not claim a new suppression executor or repeat prior implementation credit.

findings.observed: postInit awareness helper uses Suppressed shooter/instigator, hostility and range gates, per-source-group two-second cooldown and skill-scaled accumulated object reveal. Any muzzle attachment is classified as suppressed. Group knowledge array has no pruning in the inspected helper.
findings.wait: cortexHearingLocal retains a quantized expiring sound area without the shooter object.
findings.disposition: Preserve uncertain observation and bounded memory. Review actual weapon suppression classification separately. Do not import object-reveal semantics as hearing certainty.

findings.observed: FSM uses nearest-building radius plus ceiling ray, caches indoor result for eight seconds, crouches indoors and forces prone outdoors. releaseOwnedStance restores only if the applied stance still matches.
findings.wait: dangerEngineAct uses expiring stance ownership and protects committed movers.
findings.disposition: Compare geometry-sensitive indoor posture with current stance leases. Any enhancement needs movement/transform cache invalidation and must not pin CQB movers. No routing or clearance improvement established by this source.

findings.observed: Real-event timers capped at twelve seconds by default; hearing hold is separate and support-aware groups bypass it. Three aiming skills degrade from cached baseline and restore directly. Brain config sets maxSuppression to seven.
findings.wait: cortexMorale consumes native suppression alongside casualties, wounds and known threats.
findings.disposition: Review suppression normalization and interaction with current brain configuration before tuning. Preserve real pressure during movement; avoid blanket baseline restoration over newer skill changes.

findings.observed: FSM uses current attack target, short target claims, known alternates, three person-discovery samples with ninety-metre radius cap, lane checks, loaded/reserve ammunition gates and finite suppression bursts.
findings.disposition: Compare against WAIT fire-control authority, current ROE and full lane coverage. Local claims are not cross-owner coordination; capped samples need coverage proof. Do not add another firing controller.

findings.observed: Server bootstrap queues created/respawned units and reconciles allUnits every four seconds; shared monitor visits registered actors about once a second. Owner forwarding exists in attach/release helpers.
findings.disposition: Use existing bounded WAIT owner scheduler. Remaining review must trace ownership migration, stale local registration, callback authority and end-to-end cleanup; one shared handler does not imply constant cost.

findings.observed: AIsuppression checks local unit at entry. Search of continuing FSM and monitor found no local-unit exit/recheck; server reconciliation selects only server-local units. Owner forwarding at attachment alone is not ownership migration coverage.
findings.disposition: Do not port persistent monitor/FSM ownership. Retain WAIT owner epoch retirement/adoption; audit migration later rather than crediting attachment guards as handover.

licence: Bundled licence states Arma Public License - No Derivatives. No source/assets copied into production. Permission/licence disposition required before any derivative redistribution; engineering findings describe independent design requirements.
remaining: Complete untruncated AI FSM, event, settings and lifecycle review with line-level dispositions.
Verify archive manifest before relying on old snapshot beyond explicitly compared files.
Compare current WAIT suppression normalization, full-lane fire safety and indoor posture cache ownership.
Implement only justified independent improvements with regression checks; physical acceptance remains pending while audits are paused.
audioDisposition: Inspected pd_suppressive_audio config, settings and playback entry. Config registers only custom sound request and local CBA option; requestFallbackCrack requires hasInterface and player. No AI controller or CfgAmmo/brain overrides found in this addon configuration. Excluded as player audio.

independentImprovements.change: Suppression requires selected primary weapon, nonempty current muzzle with loaded rounds and damaging shotbullet ammunition; inventory reserve no longer qualifies a pistol, launcher or empty selected muzzle. No forced selection or reload. Reserve accounting is muzzle-specific and excludes loaded and empty magazines; underbarrel grenades cannot satisfy rifle reserves.
independentImprovements.offlineValidation: Complete Build terminal exit 0; 1058 tests, SQF/config/documentation/parity/performance static gates and FSM validation; 9 PBOs.

effectPathReview.scope: AI skill degradation, shared decay/disable branches, AI CBA mapping and brain config; source-only review remains incomplete.
effectPathReview.skillChanges: Three aiming skills are derived from a cached baseline with suppression power0.8 and configurable cap; courage is not degraded. Recovery uses configured half-life scaled by courage, then writes cached baseline at low stress or disable. No per-skill applied-value receipt protects a later external skill edit.
effectPathReview.documentedRange: Native suppression is documented0..1, with-1 for unavailable/disabled; source division by configured maxSuppression and synthetic floor3 need engine measurement, not an assumption of raw config-scale API values.
effectPathReview.waitFinding: CortexMorale previously summed-1 as negative pressure; now clamps local samples0..1 before averaging. Disabled/unavailable contributes zero, while the existing20% weight stays bounded. No new suppression controller, scan or skill penalty.
remaining: Trace all live AI setting disable callbacks and FSM shutdown against specialist takeover.
Measure normalized native suppression separately from configured brain maxima and explicit script writes.
Do not apply cached-baseline skill restoration over later owner changes.
Live disabled-suppression morale and end-to-end fire/morale behaviour remain unrun.
